title_en: Beautiful Places in China (13/20): Mount Hua's Cliffside Plank Walks
note_en: Chinese often splits a long sentence with 前者…后者… "the former... the latter...": 前者是凿刻在近乎垂直岩壁上的狭窄石阶，后者则是…狭长山脊. English tends to say "the first... the second..." in casual writing, but Chinese uses 前者/后者 freely even in travel writing. The 则 after 后者 adds a sense of contrast, like "while" or "on the other hand."
